LESSON: BALL TECHNIQUES

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: MODELLING
Topic 2.1: Ball TECHNIQUES

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Ball TECHNIQUES. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: how he ball technique is used modelling with?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify different types of 2 lessons modelling
2. model items using ball techniques
3. model for enjoyment
4. express their ideas, feelings and emotions through modelling. technique. appreciate own and others work. 89 area and wash their hands. Core-Competence

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify different types of 2 lessons modelling
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify different types of 2 lessons modelling. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. model items using ball techniques
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to model items using ball techniques. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. model for enjoyment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to model for enjoyment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. express their ideas, feelings and emotions through modelling. technique. appreciate own and others work. 89 area and wash their hands. Core-Competence
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to express their ideas, feelings and emotions through modelling. technique. appreciate own and others work. 89 area and wash their hands. Core-Competence. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Ball TECHNIQUES.
2. Explain Ball TECHNIQUES to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Ball TECHNIQUES.
4. Show that you can: identify different types of 2 lessons modelling
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Ball TECHNIQUES. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: how he ball technique is used modelling with?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify different types of 2 lessons modelling
2. model items using ball techniques
3. model for enjoyment
4. express their ideas, feelings and emotions through modelling. technique. appreciate own and others work. 89 area and wash their hands. Core-Competence

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
